cnc_encounter_flag_first.conversion: Mixin @Inject at HEAD (cancellable) of each of the 26 *AdvanceprocProcedure.execute(Event, LevelAccessor, DDD, Entity) (one mixin per class, generated from the jar's census): the player's PlayerVariables are read once (LazyOptional.orElse(null): no default object); when the handler's encountered_<animal> flag is already true the handler returns (one profiler getEntities, as its search counts); the four advancement handlers run the original when their advancement is not loaded (its look-up then throws). PlayerSquonkCryEffectProcedure: living / client level / Sobbing tested before its search. Exact variant (Forge no longer gathers capabilities for the throwaway head item). Runtime flag cncEncounterFlagFirst. Helper bons.furious.patch.cnc_coo49.CncScans.
